chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya (may Allah have mercy on him) said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah said: Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated from Ali ibn Ma'bad, from al-Husayn ibn Khalid, from Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (peace be upon them), that a man entered upon him.

He said to him: 'O son of the Messenger of Allah, what is the proof of the emergence of the universe?' He (AS) replied: 'You did not exist, and then you came into being. And you know that you did not create yourself, nor was your being created by someone like you.'

key_terms.لَمْ تَكُنْ ثُمَّ كُنْتَ: You did not exist, then you came into being

ai.seo_question: What is the rational proof for the creation of the universe according to Imam Ali al-Rida?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *al-Tawhid* presents the *Dalil al-Huduth* (Proof of Emergence) using the man’s self-awareness of his transition from non-existence to existence. The Imam highlights that since the individual did not create himself nor was he created by an equal, it logically necessitates a singular, transcendent Creator, establishing a foundational rational argument for *Hadith al-Alam* (the temporality of the universe) in Shia kalam.
